sources.summary:
Title: Introducing OpenAI for Chile
Final URL: https://openai.com/index/introducing-openai-for-chile/
Today we’re launching OpenAI for Chile, a partnership with the Government of Chile, led by the Ministry of Science, Technology, Knowledge and Innovation, to support responsible AI adoption in public administration, build civil servants’ skills and help local startups develop useful AI applications.
The partnership builds on Chile’s [National AI Policy and action plan⁠(opens in a new window)](htt
sources.recommend_reason_zh: OpenAI与智利政府签署MoU启动OpenAI for Chile，聚焦公务员AI培训、公共行政采用和初创扶持，设联合工作组且明确无投资或采购承诺。

en.reason: OpenAI and Chile’s Ministry of Science, Technology, Knowledge and Innovation launched OpenAI for Chile to train civil servants, support responsible AI in public administration and help startups, creating a joint working group with no investment or procurement commitments.

sources.summary: Cursor plugin specification and official plugins
sources.recommend_reason_zh: cursor/plugins 是 Cursor 官方插件仓库，收录面向开发者工具、框架和 SaaS 产品的插件，每个插件在根目录独立存放，并各自带有 .cursor-plugin/plugin.json 清单，根目录的 marketplace.json 列出所有插件，采用 MIT 许可。

en.reason: Cursor's official plugins repository hosts plugins for developer tools, frameworks and SaaS products, each in its own root-level directory with a .cursor-plugin/plugin.json manifest, all listed in marketplace.json under the MIT license.

en.reason: Cursor's official plugins repository uses a multi-plugin marketplace layout, with a root marketplace.json listing every plugin and each plugin kept in its own directory with a .cursor-plugin/plugin.json manifest, covering developer tools, frameworks and SaaS under the MIT license.
